Generating.choices: Short, nominalized or participial forms were chosen across all languages to ensure the status badge does not overflow at 320px or 360px.

locales.ja: 生成中 uses 3 kanji characters and is standard in Japanese UI badges.
locales.es: Generando is an active gerund that stays well within chip width.
locales.fr: Génération was selected over the longer Génération en cours to avoid badge truncation.
locales.de: Wird generiert represents the standard passive progressive state cleanly.
locales.pt_BR: Gerando is the natural Brazilian Portuguese active form.
locales.zh_CN: 生成中 is concise and standard in modern generative AI tools.
locales.it: In generazione fits badge dimensions while expressing progressive action.
locales.zh_TW: 生成中 aligns with contemporary Traditional Chinese AI terminology.
locales.hi: जनरेट हो रहा है uses established transliterated technology vocabulary.

locales.fr: À vérifier is concise and standard for items awaiting inspection.
locales.de: Prüfung erforderlich avoids imperative commands like Prüfen while remaining formal.
locales.pt_BR: Requer verificação conveys state objectively without commanding action.
locales.zh_CN: 需要检查 clearly states that inspection is warranted.

locales.zh_TW: 需要檢查 maintains exact semantic parity with Simplified Chinese while respecting Traditional conventions.

terminology_caveats: Product brand preservation: The proper noun Gemini Notebook is kept verbatim across all eleven locales. It is not transliterated, translated, or declined.

Common noun handling: In the explanatory sentences, 'this notebook' refers to a generic document instance. In Spanish (cuaderno), French (carnet), and Brazilian Portuguese (caderno), natural localized nouns were used. In Italian and German, 'notebook' is widely retained as a recognized loanword in software contexts, but 'taccuino' (Italian) or 'Notizbuch' (German) remain valid alternatives if full localization is preferred.
Extension context: These strings are bespoke extension messages, not official or verified Google UI copy. No claim of native speaker review or internal Google interface inspection is made.

Layout and length considerations: In 320px and 360px rows, multi-sentence messages will wrap over two to three lines. The translations avoid redundant filler words to prevent excessive vertical height.
Formality: Polite neutral direct address forms are used where applicable, such as Sie in German and polite imperative forms in Korean and Japanese.
